name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: B2B SaaS Customer Success & Account Growth Leader
summary: Customer success and account growth leader with ~94% retention across a 15-20 partner portfolio and 15+ years in B2B SaaS, MarTech, and agency environments. At Wix, carried combined commercial and post-sale ownership at 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets; today, as founder of Solenzo, owns onboarding, adoption, reporting, and account-expansion recommendations for B2B clients. Builds executive relationships, customer-health operating rhythms, and AI-enabled lifecycle systems in HubSpot and GoHighLevel.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of service-based businesses, running discovery and onboarding to surface goals and market challenges, then managing day-to-day value delivery on complex SaaS platforms.
Identify opportunities to expand retainer scope, recommending and scoping complementary services aligned with client objectives.
Develop full-lifecycle customer strategies spanning demand generation, CRM architecture, onboarding, and customer success, tying programs to clear ROI and revenue growth.

Design and deploy automated lifecycle sequences, onboarding workflows, and CRM architectures that activate, nurture, and retain high-value users; built 20+ GoHighLevel workflows across capture, qualification, booking, onboarding, reactivation, and reviews.

Track acquisition and retention across accounts using GA4 and CRM analytics, building dashboards for funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity and delivering recommendations to owners and executives.

Translate non-technical stakeholder feedback into precise AI prompts and agent instructions, bridging business intent to reliable LLM output while documenting interactions, timelines, and deliverables in HubSpot, GoHighLevel, and Notion.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed integrated digital marketing strategies across inbound, paid media, and content as strategic lead, coordinating execution across distributed internal teams.
Built campaign reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering QBRs and optimization recommendations to senior stakeholders.
Resolved client feedback promptly and held delivery quality consistent across implementations to protect satisfaction and retention.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K), retaining all but one (~94%) during tenure.
Led onboarding and training for a high-volume partner network, driving adoption of marketing automation and reputation management solutions.
Advised partners on retention strategy, customer health metrics, and automated workflows, equipping them to communicate product value.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to share structured, high-priority customer feedback that informed the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Closed 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K each (several above $25K), generating roughly $130K+ in total bookings.
Ran client accounts end to end across campaign execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication, while refining processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, reaching 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets across a role that combined commercial and post-sale ownership.
Led onboarding and launch operations as team lead and primary strategic contact, delivering launches on time and accelerating time-to-value.
Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists, overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.
Drove process improvements for a new Wix vertical that moved from proof of concept to a profitable business line, contributing to hiring, onboarding, and training.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Sold and scoped complex CRM and project-management software to agencies and professional-services firms, advising C-suite executives on operational system design, adoption, and scalable workflows.
Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, troubleshooting technical challenges and escalating account risk early.
Ranked top three in sales on a team of 8 to 15 reps for nearly the full tenure while quota roughly doubled.
Averaged ~$17,750/month in implementation and services bookings (~$213K annualized) plus recurring revenue, consistently performing into accelerator tiers.
